doc.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998

title: Wishing the Sauter-Finegan years longer
summary: Sauter-Finegan would be the part of life to sustain; wishes his wife were present.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: If there is one part of your life that you could have sustained longer, would it have been the Sauter-Finegan band?
Yeah. Notice how long it took me answer that.
Notice I didn’t even have to ask the question.
The only other thing is I wish my wife were here to enjoy this. © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-
Because she’d grin a mile wide hearing me talk like this. And we were both so proud of our daughter Krissy. We’ve been blessed.
Well it’s great that you have documentation of that period of your life.
Well it’s something I can’t forget, don’t want to forget, and I’m lucky to have known.
